description: Hi, we're Analog Orbit, a small team working on the Flame in Freefall challenge for NASA Space Apps Warangal 2026. We are final-year Aeronautical Engineering student. Working with Python, MATLAB, AutoCAD and ANSYS (CFD), and I'm doing my final-year project on winglets, so I'm comfortable with flow and combustion-style data. We're keeping the scope small and finishing in two days, so you'll get a clear project and something solid to show for your portfolio.
